published: President of China XI Jinping (since 14 March 2013)
process: president indirectly elected by National People's Congress for a 5-year term (eligible for a second term); chief executive chosen by a 400-member Election Committee for a 5-year term (eligible for a second term)
results: 2024: Sam Hou FAI (unopposed; received 394 out of 400 votes); 2019: HO lat Seng (unopposed; received 392 out of 400 votes)
governmentType: executive-led limited democracy; a special administrative region of the People's Republic of China
cabinet: Executive Council appointed by the chief executive
